name: text-animate
title: Text Animate
description: A text animation component that animates text using a variety of different animations.
usage:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TextAnimate } from '@/components/ui/text-animate'
</script>

<template>
  <TextAnimate text="Blur in by character" animation="blurInUp" by="character" once />

  <!-- or pass the text through the default slot -->
  <TextAnimate animation="slideUp" by="word">Slide up by word</TextAnimate>
</template>

props.name: text
props.description: The text to animate. When omitted, the plain-text content of the default slot is used instead (Magic UI's `children`).

props.name: segmentClass
props.description: Classes applied to every animated segment (Magic UI's `segmentClassName`).

props.name: delay
props.description: Seconds to wait before the first segment animates.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds over which the segments are staggered in.

props.name: variants
props.description: Custom `hidden` / `show` / `exit` variants for each segment. Each segment receives `index * stagger` as its `custom` value. Replaces the `animation` preset.

props.name: by
props.description: How the text is split into animated segments.

props.name: startOnView
props.description: Wait until the element scrolls into view before animating.

props.name: once
props.description: Only animate the first time the element enters the viewport.

props.name: accessible
props.description: Render the full string for screen readers (`aria-label` + `sr-only` copy) and hide the split segments from them.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Plain text to animate, used when the `text` prop is not set. Markup inside the slot is flattened to its text.
